## Appearance

Charlie Sloane is a boy characterized by his distinct goggle eyes.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P23](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0023)_

## Personality

Charlie Sloane harbors clear ambitions for his future. He aspires to enter the political sphere and eventually serve as a member of Parliament.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)_

## History

Charlie Sloane is a local student who attends the same school as [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). He is part of the cohort of pupils present during the academic term taught by Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md). Charlie later continues his education alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and his peers as part of the advanced class organized by Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) to prepare students for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XV.
